submitted.rationale: Out of 5 EQE measurements, Sb 0.19 (index 3) gave the highest EQE, 0.075%. EQE rises from Sb 0.12 (0.053%) to 0.19, then falls at 0.25 (0.046%). It is about zero at 0.49 and 0.75. XRD patterns at Sb 0.19, 0.25 and 0.31 are almost the same: the strongest peak is at Q≈1.88, which looks like a rutile-type FeSbO4 phase with extra Fe. So the change in EQE probably comes from composition and defects, not from a phase change. The peak EQE is near Sb≈0.19.
